Email campaigns 12 of 58 since 2026-01: all 12 showed base prices, with the base price in the largest type. Social posts 20: 9 showed base prices only. On-sale page captures for 5 of the 22 high-demand on-sales: 'limit 8 per customer' text; the platform checks the limit per account. Test orders on 3 events: orders with a wheelchair space stopped at 4 seats. Price-change logs for 14 reserved-seat Amphitheater and Music Hall shows (March to July 2026): accessible seating price levels were raised above other seats in the same section on 2 shows. The virtual terminal phone script states the final amount before charging

title: Gap analysis interviews
source_system: Interviews (Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer, General Counsel, IT Director, Security Manager, Vice President of Ticketing, Vice President of Marketing and Digital, Director of Premium Seating and Group Sales, Vice President of Venue Operations, Director of Food and Beverage, HR Director, Controller, finance staff)
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of how each requirement is carried out today. Premium staff typed card numbers and security codes into CRM notes for later installment charges; nobody is assigned card data retention or disposal; nobody watches event page scripts or headers for changes; nobody reviews ticketing administrator activity, bulk exports, tag manager publishes or CMS changes; touring crews bring their own access points and the venues have no wireless scanning; finance staff interviewed did not know the merchant agreement's 24-hour notice term; the General Counsel is reviewing whether Texas privacy law applies

title: Control assessment: account management
source_system: Ticketing user export (186 users); identity provider export; POL-02; samples of 25 of 96 terminations, 25 of 51 transfers and 25 new accounts; Vice President of Ticketing interview
what_it_shows: SSO accounts and all sampled new accounts followed the documented process; the 4 agency accounts were created by vendor support at the agency's request with no company approval; the 11 local accounts were created outside the documented process; 6 of 25 sampled transfers kept prior ticketing roles; 2 accounts of departed agency staff still enabled; 3 of 25 sampled leavers had local or badge access removed 2 to 9 days late; disabled local accounts are not removed and 3 were unused for more than 90 days; no review of ticketing administrator activity or exports; the agency does not report staff departures; the last access review was January 2026; break-glass passwords not changed after 2 IT staff left in 2026

title: Control assessment: least privilege
source_system: Ticketing role export; API key list; endpoint local administrator exception list
what_it_shows: 14 ticketing administrators against a stated need of 6; the sync function's API key has full administrator scope; 22 laptops keep local administrator rights

title: Control assessment: privileged accounts
source_system: Privileged account lists for the identity provider, ticketing, CMS, network devices and cloud; access broker policy
what_it_shows: Just-in-time elevation covers cloud administrator roles only; identity provider, ticketing, CMS and network administrators hold standing rights

title: Control assessment: remote access
source_system: VPN policy; integrator remote tool review; IT Director and integrator lead technician interviews
what_it_shows: VPN use and connection requirements are documented in POL-02 and the network standard; no implementation guidance for third-party remote tools; the integrator's remote tool connections are not authorized per connection and use password-only sign-in

title: Control assessment: literacy training
source_system: Training system report (2026 completion 96%); records sample of 25 of 600; phishing simulation results; 15 staff interviews
what_it_shows: Training at hire and annually with phishing simulations; no training when the virtual terminal channel and the tag manager were introduced, and no privacy training when the chatbot and marketing scoring were introduced; content not updated after the 2026 card data discovery or with lessons from the 2025 payment fraud attempt

title: Control assessment: event logging
source_system: SIEM source list; log settings for 9 systems; STD-02 draft
what_it_shows: Event types identified for identity, cloud, firewall and EDR sources; none specified for the ticketing tenant, tag manager, CMS or payment partner portal, and those sources are not logged to the SIEM; no recorded rationale; event types not reviewed since the SIEM was deployed in 2024; logging not coordinated with the ticketing and marketing owners

title: Control assessment: audit record review
source_system: MSSP monthly reports January to June 2026; alert escalation records; query of the ticketing audit log for bulk exports in July 2026
what_it_shows: The MSSP reports findings to the Security Manager; no review of ticketing administrator activity, bulk exports, tag manager publishes or virtual terminal activity; the query found 3 bulk exports in July 2026 that nobody had reviewed (all later confirmed legitimate); review level not raised during high-demand on-sales

title: Control assessment: audit record retention
source_system: Retention settings for 9 systems
what_it_shows: Ticketing audit log kept 90 days at the vendor and CMS logs 14 days; the draft POL-03 and STD-02 set 12 months

title: Control assessment: audit record generation
source_system: Log configuration of cloud, identity provider, firewalls and CMS servers
what_it_shows: Audit record generation is provided and the security team selects event types; CMS servers keep logs only locally; ticketing audit records are not collected

title: Control assessment: penetration testing
source_system: 2025 external test report; testing calendar
what_it_shows: Only an external website test (2025); no internal or segmentation test; no documented methodology

title: Control assessment: baseline configuration
source_system: Device management profiles; cloud image list; SD-WAN, CMS and VMS configuration reviews
what_it_shows: Laptop and cloud image baselines exist and are reviewed; no documented baseline or configuration control for CMS servers, SD-WAN edges or VMS servers; baselines not updated when the crowd analytics servers were installed in 2026-04

title: Control assessment: configuration change control
source_system: Change tickets: 25 of 61 infrastructure changes and 25 of 214 ticketing setting changes January to June 2026; tag manager publish history
what_it_shows: Infrastructure changes reviewed, approved, documented and retained by the weekly change board (24 of 25 sampled approved); 0 of 25 sampled ticketing setting changes had a change record; tag manager publishes not monitored or reviewed; no security or privacy impact analysis for the dynamic pricing module or the chatbot

title: Control assessment: configuration settings
source_system: Guardrail policy; laptop exception list; configuration review of 10 servers; default-credential test on 12 integrator-installed devices
what_it_shows: Deviations and changes are monitored and controlled for laptops and cloud resources; no documented settings for CMS servers and VMS servers; the Music Hall crowd analytics server still used the integrator's default administrator password

title: Control assessment: least functionality
source_system: Browser capture of 10 event pages on 2026-08-11; tag manager export; firewall rule sets
what_it_shows: The capture showed 33 scripts on pages that embed the checkout form, 2 more than on 2026-07-20 (a sponsor campaign tag and a chat widget loader); essential capabilities for those pages not defined; unapproved software blocked on laptops and unneeded services disabled on cloud servers; management ports open from the corporate segment to the physical security segment

title: Control assessment: system component inventory
source_system: IT asset register; cloud inventory; POS vendor and payment partner device lists; reconciliation at 3 venues
what_it_shows: The register avoids duplicates and tracks components at a usable level; it does not show PCI DSS scope or business owner and omits 4 VMS servers; 3 of 284 POS devices on the vendor list could not be located; device lists not reconciled quarterly

title: Control assessment: contingency plan
source_system: IT continuity plan 2024; Amphitheater manual entry procedure; BIA (P05); venue General Manager interviews
what_it_shows: The 2024 plan covers restoration of the cloud workloads, is approved and protected, and is coordinated with incident handling; it does not identify event-day functions, its recovery objectives predate the BIA, it has no metrics, 4 of 12 contacts have left the company, it was not distributed to the venue General Managers or the Director of Safety and Security, and it has not been reviewed since 2024 or updated for the Amphitheater or the County PAC; no procedure keeps entry running at the Music Hall and the Club

title: Control assessment: contingency plan testing
source_system: Test records request; IT Director interview
what_it_shows: No test of the contingency plan for company workloads; no test criteria, results or corrective actions

title: Control assessment: system backup
source_system: Backup reports (30 of 30 July 2026 jobs); vault lock settings; restore of one CMS folder from the backup account on 2026-08-13
what_it_shows: 30 of 30 July 2026 daily backups completed to the separate account with 35-day write-once retention and separate credentials; the test restore of one CMS folder succeeded

title: Control assessment: identification and authentication
source_system: Identity provider export; ticketing user export; scanner login review
what_it_shows: 2 break-glass ticketing admin accounts shared by the IT team; 9 local accounts outside SSO; the identity provider associates each authenticated user with that user's processes

title: Control assessment: MFA for privileged accounts
source_system: MFA sign-in test on 25 sampled federated privileged accounts; ticketing and tag manager settings
what_it_shows: All 25 sampled federated administrators were prompted for MFA; the 2 local ticketing admin accounts and the 9 tag manager publishers sign in with a password only

title: Control assessment: authenticator management
source_system: Password policies for 4 systems; API key list; default-credential test on 12 integrator-installed devices (after hours, integrator present)
what_it_shows: Local ticketing accounts allow 8-character passwords; the integrator's default administrator password worked on the Music Hall crowd analytics server (stop-and-notify used 2026-08-12); the full-admin ticketing API key has not been rotated since 2024 and is stored in plain function settings; shared break-glass passwords not changed when group membership changed; other authenticator steps followed

title: Control assessment: incident handling
source_system: Incident queue (41 incidents 2025-2026; sample of 10); 2024 plan; MSSP escalation records; simulated after-hours MSSP escalation test 2026-08-13
what_it_shows: The 10 sampled incidents went through detection, containment, eradication and recovery with comparable rigor and results; no card compromise preparation (no evidence preservation steps for SaaS platforms, no PFI or acquirer procedures); handling not coordinated with venue emergency plans; lessons from the 2025 payment fraud attempt not incorporated; venue incidents handled by venue managers outside the queue

title: Control assessment: incident reporting
source_system: 15 staff interviews; POL-03; finance team interview
what_it_shows: 14 of 15 staff knew to report a suspected incident within 1 hour and how; finance staff did not know the acquirer's 24-hour notice term or the card brand reporting path

title: Control assessment: incident response plan
source_system: 2024 incident response plan; draft P08 runbooks; crisis team interviews
what_it_shows: The 2024 plan sets the structure, approach, resources and responsibilities and is protected; it does not address card compromise, event-day operations, reportable incidents for card data or the County PAC, metrics, or sharing with the acquirer, card brands and the county; not reviewed or approved since 2024, not distributed to the crisis management team or the venue General Managers, and not updated for the Amphitheater, the virtual terminal or website changes; the draft P08 runbooks cover card compromise and event-day outages

title: Control assessment: media sanitization
source_system: Destruction certificates (10 of 10 devices returned in 2026); laptop wipe records; premium files walkthrough
what_it_shows: Destruction certificates and wipe records on file for the 10 devices returned in 2026; 2 of 6 printed premium files reviewed held card numbers and had been kept

title: Control assessment: physical access control
source_system: Walkthroughs of 4 sites 2026-08-11 to 2026-08-13; badge system report
what_it_shows: Physical access authorizations enforced and logged, public areas controlled and visitors escorted at the 4 sites; no visitor control at box office back rooms; keys to 2 of 9 venue network closets not secured, logged or inventoried, and not changed when holders leave

title: Control assessment: personnel termination
source_system: Termination sample 25 of 96 against identity provider, ticketing and badge records
what_it_shows: 3 of 25 leavers had local ticketing or badge access removed 2 to 9 days late; agency and local credentials are not revoked through the termination process; exit interviews, property return and access to records followed for the sampled items

title: Control assessment: vulnerability monitoring and scanning
source_system: Internal scan reports 6 of 6 months; ASV reports 4 of 4 quarters; all 18 critical findings January to June 2026
what_it_shows: Monitoring, scan reports and result sharing are in place; scans exclude corporate segment laptops, SD-WAN edges and VMS servers; a critical CMS plug-in vulnerability stayed open 46 days against a 30-day target

title: Control assessment: external system services
source_system: Vendor files for 12 service providers; contracts; AOCs
what_it_shows: The ticketing vendor's and the payment partner's AOCs show PCI DSS controls; the agency and tag manager vendor contracts carry no security requirements and tag vendors no privacy requirements; oversight of providers and a PCI DSS responsibility matrix are not documented for any provider; no ongoing monitoring; the payment partner AOC on file is from 2024

title: Control assessment: boundary protection
source_system: Rule sets for 4 sites; traffic tests from a virtual terminal laptop and a corporate laptop at HQ and the Music Hall 2026-08-12
what_it_shows: External interfaces are monitored and controlled, with the website behind the web edge; from the corporate segment the tests reached the physical security and production segments; the virtual terminal laptops are not separated from the corporate segment; no monitoring between internal segments

title: Control assessment: malicious code protection
source_system: EDR console export; EICAR test on 5 endpoints
what_it_shows: EDR active and updating on the 5 test endpoints; all EICAR files quarantined within 4 minutes and the MSSP alerted

title: Control assessment: system monitoring
source_system: SIEM use case list; MSSP reports; simulated impossible-travel sign-in test 2026-08-13
what_it_shows: The MSSP escalated the simulated sign-in in 22 minutes; integrator remote tool connections, ticketing administrator use, activity inside the CDE segments and SaaS administrative activity are not monitored; monitoring not increased during high-demand on-sales

title: Control assessment: software and information integrity
source_system: Payment page monitoring plan; P2PE listings; CMS server review
what_it_shows: No integrity verification of scripts or CMS code on payment-related pages and no detection of changes to page content or HTTP headers; no defined actions for unauthorized script or content changes; P2PE device firmware integrity is verified by the solution providers per their listings

title: Control assessment: supplier assessments and reviews
source_system: Vendor files; P09 review plan
what_it_shows: Supplier risk is assessed only at onboarding; tag vendors and agencies have never been assessed
